snippet.title: The Northsong Rift Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Northsong, nestled in the northernmost parts of Kurasin. This town has seen all kinds of travelers pass through—miners, adventurers, merchants, military, and messengers—but never a member of the Elatus Guard.

Join Leon Yarrow as he investigates a mysterious rift to the underworld, a phenomenon not seen near settlements for centuries. As Leon delves deeper, he uncovers secrets that challenge his understanding of reality and the true nature of the rift.

Special thanks to Baz https://youtube.com/@BazSupport for massive edits on the trailer, feedback, and testing of the game! Absolute legend!
